dct_title_s: Alexandrie : Plan général des deux ports, de la ville moderne, et de la ville des Arabes
dct_description_sm: Levé par les Ingénieurs de l'Armée d'Orient ; [gravée par] Capitaine Cordier Adjudant de la place de Paris
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian
Bar scales on map below lower neatline: "1000 Toises", "10 Stades de 95t", "Mille Romain de 756t", "Mètres", "Stades de 51t", "Stades de 76t"
Relief shown by soundings, hachures, and shading
Date derived from note that map was drawn by Ingénieurs de l'Armée d'Orient, which was active in Egypt 1798-1801
